title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep – Lucia & Samir (API / Console / Dedicated / Private)
meeting_agenda: Quick sync (3m) – how's the week going? blockers
API stability post-rate-limit changes (10m) – rollout status + error spikes
Console UX changes for rollout control (10m) – canary + rollback UX flow
Dedicated capacity autoscale rules (8m) – current incidents and tuning
Private deployment onboarding checklist (7m) – KMS/HSM and network docs gaps
Prioritization & tradeoffs (7m) – which task to push for next sprint
content:
Context: Samir is Eng Lead for API and Console. We're 2 weeks into the new rate-limit config (soft limits + 429 backoff) and saw a small spike in 500s on bursty endpoints. Dedicated autoscale tuning has improved p99 tail but we still see occasional cold-start latencies for large models. Private onboarding interest from two mid-market customers scheduled for pilot in April; need clearer docs and checklist for KMS/HSM and private control plane networking.

Goals for this 1:1:
- Surface recent infra anomalies and decide next steps (rollback vs mitigation).
- Align Console UX for rollout controls so PM can draft release notes and docs.
- Confirm owners for Dedicated autoscale follow-ups and Private onboarding checklist.

Key discussion points / notes to bring up:
- API error spike (last 48h): small cluster of 500s tied to 12:30–13:00 PST bursts on text-completion endpoint. Suspect autoscaling lag + longer model compile times on new quantized variants. Ask Samir if we should temporarily pin model variant for high-throughput routes.
- Observability: need an event-level tag in traces that indicates "rate-limit-tier" so we can correlate 429 vs 500. Raised in ENG-4521 but not prioritized. Ask for ETA to add trace tag.
- Console rollout UX: current canary flow doesn't show per-region fallback options clearly. Product needs a simple toggle to "enable region fallback" (defaults for enterprise). Samir – can the backend support this flag and wiring to rollout service? If not, what's the alternative?
- Dedicated: autoscale policy tied to GPU pool target_util of 70% is still causing oscillation during synthetic traffic. Propose adding hysteresis (min up-time + cooldown) and a short-lived warm pool. Need Samir to scope effort (est 3–5 dev days).
- Private deployments: two pilots (AcmeHealth, FinServCo). Missing items: KMS integration guide, network diagram for private control plane, checklist for customer-side firewall rules. Ask Samir for an internal owner from SRE/infra and a review slot next week.
- Rollouts & docs: If we move to temporary pin of model variant for high-throughput routes, update Console + API release notes and add an internal playbook for rollback. PM to draft, Samir to review.
notes:
Open questions to ask Samir:
- Can we get quick pin of older model variant for /v1/generate-high-throughput for next 48h? (risk: slightly higher cost)
- ETA to add 'rate-limit-tier' trace tag to APM?
- Backend readiness for per-region fallback toggle in rollout service?
- Owner for Private onboarding docs (SRE or infra?)

Triage suggestion (for meeting):
1) Confirm hotfix (pin variant) decision in 5–10m if spike still present.
2) Assign follow-ups with owners and dates.

Tone/asks for Samir: clear ask + cost tradeoff. I want a yes/no on the pin in-meeting and realistic ETA for autoscale hysteresis (dev days + QA).
action_items: Lucia: Draft rollback playbook + release note snippet for model-variant pinning (due 2026-03-04)
Samir: Decide on temporary model-variant pin for /v1/generate-high-throughput and confirm by EOD 2026-03-02
Samir: Scope autoscale hysteresis + warm-pool changes (estimate dev days) and post summary to ENG-4521 (due 2026-03-06)
Samir: Assign SRE/infra owner for Private onboarding docs and schedule review with PM (due 2026-03-09)
Lucia + Docs: Start KMS/HSM integration guide draft using customer questions from FinServCo (due 2026-03-10)
Samir + Observability: Add 'rate-limit-tier' tag to traces or provide workaround instrumentation (ETA requested by 2026-03-08)
Lucia: Update Console UX spec to include 'region fallback' toggle and walkthrough (share by 2026-03-05)
Samir: Quick runbook for ops to handle 500-spike (temp pin + alert thresholds) and link to on-call (due 2026-03-04)
